input.pr_title: feat: implement two-level review workflow (brand + compliance)
input.pr_description:
Implements two-level content review workflow for the Creator Campaign Collaboration Platform.

## Changes
- New Review model with brand and compliance review types
- ReviewRepository with CRUD + content-type lookups
- ReviewService with submit_review (role-based authorization) and automatic content status updates
- API endpoints: submit review, list reviews for content
- Content status automatically transitions based on combined review decisions (both approvals needed for full approval; any rejection or revision request updates content accordingly)

## Follows existing patterns
- Repository pattern (ContentRepository reference)
- Service layer with custom exceptions
- FastAPI router with deps injection

+from fastapi import APIRouter
+
+from app.api.deps import CurrentUser, DBSession
+from app.repositories.campaign_repo import CampaignRepository
+from app.repositories.content_repo import ContentRepository
+from app.repositories.review_repo import ReviewRepository
+from app.schemas.review import ReviewCreate, ReviewResponse
+from app.services.review_service import ReviewService
+
+router = APIRouter()
+
+
+def _get_service(db: DBSession) -> ReviewService:
+    return ReviewService(
+        ReviewRepository(db),
+        ContentRepository(db),
+        CampaignRepository(db),
+    )
+
+
+@router.post(
+    "/contents/{content_id}/reviews",
+    response_model=ReviewResponse,
+    status_code=201,
+)
+async def submit_review(
+    db: DBSession,
+    current_user: CurrentUser,
+    content_id: str,
+    data: ReviewCreate,
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.submit_review(content_id, current_user, data)
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/contents/{content_id}/reviews",
+    response_model=list[ReviewResponse],
+)
+async def list_reviews(
+    db: DBSession,
+    content_id: str,
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.list_reviews(content_id)

+import enum
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    DateTime,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Index,
+    Integer,
+    String,
+    Text,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
+
+from app.models.base import Base, TimestampMixin, generate_uuid
+
+
+class ReviewType(enum.Enum):
+    BRAND = "brand"
+    COMPLIANCE = "compliance"
+
+
+class ReviewDecision(enum.Enum):
+    PENDING = "pending"
+    APPROVED = "approved"
+    REJECTED = "rejected"
+    REVISION_REQUESTED = "revision_requested"
+
+
+class Review(Base, TimestampMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "reviews"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    content_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("contents.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    reviewer_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    review_type: Mapped[ReviewType] = mapped_column(nullable=False)
+    decision: Mapped[ReviewDecision] = mapped_column(
+        nullable=False, default=ReviewDecision.PENDING
+    )
+    comments: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
+    decided_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
+        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
+    )
+    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_reviews_content_id", "content_id"),
+        Index("ix_reviews_reviewer_id", "reviewer_id"),
+        Index("ix_reviews_content_type", "content_id", "review_type"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<Review {self.review_type.value}:{self.decision.value}>"

+from sqlalchemy import select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from app.models.review import Review, ReviewType
+
+
+class ReviewRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_id(self, review_id: str) -> Review | None:
+        query = select(Review).where(Review.id == review_id)
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def get_by_content_and_type(
+        self, content_id: str, review_type: ReviewType
+    ) -> Review | None:
+        query = select(Review).where(
+            Review.content_id == content_id,
+            Review.review_type == review_type,
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def list_by_content(self, content_id: str) -> list[Review]:
+        query = (
+            select(Review)
+            .where(Review.content_id == content_id)
+            .order_by(Review.created_at.asc())
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return list(result.scalars().all())
+
+    async def create(self, review: Review) -> Review:
+        self.db.add(review)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(review)
+        return review
+
+    async def update(self, review: Review) -> Review:
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(review)
+        return review

diff --git a/app/services/review_service.py b/app/services/review_service.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a7b2c3f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/services/review_service.py
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from app.models.content import ContentStatus
+from app.models.review import Review, ReviewDecision, ReviewType
+from app.models.user import User, UserRole
+from app.repositories.campaign_repo import CampaignRepository
+from app.repositories.content_repo import ContentRepository
+from app.repositories.review_repo import ReviewRepository
+from app.schemas.review import ReviewCreate, ReviewResponse
+from app.utils.exceptions import ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
+
+
+class ReviewService:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        review_repo: ReviewRepository,
+        content_repo: ContentRepository,
+        campaign_repo: CampaignRepository,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.review_repo = review_repo
+        self.content_repo = content_repo
+        self.campaign_repo = campaign_repo
+
+    async def submit_review(
+        self,
+        content_id: str,
+        reviewer: User,
+        data: ReviewCreate,
+    ) -> ReviewResponse:
+        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
+        if content is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
+
+        if content.status != ContentStatus.SUBMITTED:
+            raise ValidationError("Content must be in 'submitted' status to review")
+
+        if data.review_type == ReviewType.BRAND:
+            campaign = await self.campaign_repo.get_by_id(content.campaign_id)
+            if campaign is None:
+                raise NotFoundError("Campaign", content.campaign_id)
+            if campaign.brand_id != reviewer.id:
+                raise ForbiddenError("You do not own this campaign")
+
+        elif data.review_type == ReviewType.COMPLIANCE:
+            if reviewer.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
+                raise ForbiddenError("Only admins can perform compliance reviews")
+
+        review = Review(
+            content_id=content_id,
+            reviewer_id=reviewer.id,
+            review_type=data.review_type,
+            decision=data.decision,
+            comments=data.comments,
+        )
+        review = await self.review_repo.create(review)
+
+        await self._update_content_status(content)
+
+        return ReviewResponse.model_validate(review)
+
+    async def list_reviews(
+        self, content_id: str
+    ) -> list[ReviewResponse]:
+        content = await self.content_repo.get_by_id(content_id)
+        if content is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Content", content_id)
+
+        reviews = await self.review_repo.list_by_content(content_id)
+        return [ReviewResponse.model_validate(r) for r in reviews]
+
+    async def _update_content_status(self, content) -> None:
+        reviews = await self.review_repo.list_by_content(content.id)
+
+        has_rejection = any(r.decision == ReviewDecision.REJECTED for r in reviews)
+        has_revision = any(
+            r.decision == ReviewDecision.REVISION_REQUESTED for r in reviews
+        )
+
+        if has_rejection:
+            content.status = ContentStatus.REJECTED
+            content.version += 1
+            await self.content_repo.update(content)
+            return
+
+        if has_revision:
+            revision_review = next(
+                r for r in reviews if r.decision == ReviewDecision.REVISION_REQUESTED
+            )
+            content.status = ContentStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED
+            content.revision_notes = revision_review.comments
+            content.revision_count += 1
+            content.version += 1
+            await self.content_repo.update(content)
+            return
+
+        brand_review = next(
+            (r for r in reviews if r.review_type == ReviewType.BRAND), None
+        )
+        compliance_review = next(
+            (r for r in reviews if r.review_type == ReviewType.COMPLIANCE), None
+        )
+
+        if (
+            brand_review
+            and brand_review.decision == ReviewDecision.APPROVED
+            and compliance_review
+            and compliance_review.decision == ReviewDecision.APPROVED
+        ):
+            content.status = ContentStatus.APPROVED
+            content.version += 1
+            await self.content_repo.update(content)

planted_defects.title: No duplicate review prevention allows multiple reviews of same type per content
planted_defects.description: The submit_review method does not check whether a review of the same type (brand or compliance) already exists for the content. A brand user can submit multiple brand reviews for the same content submission, and an admin can submit multiple compliance reviews. This leads to inconsistent state in _update_content_status which assumes at most one review per type (using next() to find the brand/compliance review). Duplicate reviews can cause conflicting decisions and corrupt content status transitions.
planted_defects.root_cause: The duplicate check using review_repo.get_by_content_and_type() is missing entirely. The repository method exists but is never called in the service.

expected_location.line_hint: After the role-based authorization checks, before creating the Review object

planted_defects.suggested_fix:
Add a duplicate check before creating the review:
```python
existing = await self.review_repo.get_by_content_and_type(content_id, data.review_type)
if existing is not None:
    raise ValidationError(f"A {data.review_type.value} review already exists for this content")
```

planted_defects.title: Review decision timestamp (decided_at) never set, remains None after approval/rejection
planted_defects.description: When a review is created with a decision (approved, rejected, or revision_requested), the decided_at field is never populated. The Review model has a decided_at column (DateTime with timezone), but the service never sets it. This means there is no audit trail of when review decisions were actually made. For compliance and dispute resolution, knowing the exact timestamp of a review decision is critical. The response schema exposes decided_at but it will always be None.
planted_defects.root_cause: The Review object is constructed without setting decided_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc). The import also only imports datetime without timezone, confirming this was an oversight.

expected_location.line_hint: Review(...) constructor call — missing decided_at parameter

planted_defects.suggested_fix:
Set decided_at when creating the review:
```python
from datetime import datetime, timezone
...
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
review = Review(
    ...,
    decided_at=now,
)
```

planted_defects.title: No validation prevents creating a review with 'pending' decision via API
planted_defects.description: The ReviewDecision enum includes PENDING as a value (used as the model default), but the API allows a reviewer to explicitly submit a review with decision='pending'. This is semantically invalid — 'pending' should only be a system-set initial state, not a user-submitted decision. A pending review would count as a review in _update_content_status but would never resolve, potentially blocking the content from reaching approved status. The ReviewCreate schema's Field description says 'One of: approved, rejected, revision_requested' but this is not enforced.
planted_defects.root_cause: There is no validation check to reject ReviewDecision.PENDING as an input decision. The schema accepts it because it uses the full ReviewDecision enum.

expected_location.line_hint: After role-based checks, before the Review object is created

planted_defects.suggested_fix:
Add a validation check:
```python
if data.decision == ReviewDecision.PENDING:
    raise ValidationError("Decision cannot be 'pending'")
```
Alternatively, exclude PENDING from the ReviewCreate schema by using a constrained enum or Literal type.
